# cronwiz.dev

> AI Cron Expression Generator with Job Monitoring

## What is cronwiz?

cronwiz.dev is a free AI-powered tool that generates, explains, and validates cron expressions for 7+ platforms. Type schedules in plain English and get production-ready cron syntax for Linux, AWS EventBridge, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, and Quartz/Spring.

## Site structure

- / — Homepage with interactive cron generator tool
- /explain — Cron expression explainer (paste any cron, get plain-English breakdown)
- /validate — Cross-platform cron syntax validator
- /test — Preview next 10 scheduled runs for any cron expression

## Key features

- Plain English to cron expression conversion
- 7+ platform support (Linux, AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Cloudflare, Quartz/Spring)
- Timezone and DST handling
- Platform-specific warnings (plan limits, syntax differences)
- Edge case detection (impossible dates, ambiguous fields)

## Pricing

- Free: Cron generator, explainer, validator — no signup required
- Plus ($5/mo): 25 cron monitors, AI explainer, Slack/Discord alerts, 90-day history (coming Q3 2026)
